competitors.name: Prisma Migrate
competitors.description: Declarative database schema migration tool for Node.js and TypeScript.
complaints: Dangerous table lock migrations executed without warning on production databases
Difficult to write custom raw SQL migrations alongside declarative schemas
Shadow database requirements make CI/CD pipelines slow and fragile
Forces an ORM-first approach that doesn't work for complex queries

competitors.name: Flyway
competitors.description: Database migration tool strongly favoring plain SQL and version control.
complaints: Advanced rollback and automated drift detection locked behind enterprise licensing
Does not analyze query locks or table size risks before applying changes
Configuration is XML-heavy and feels stuck in the Java enterprise era

competitors.name: Liquibase
competitors.description: Database schema change management and deployment automation.
complaints: Changelog XML/YAML format is verbose and error-prone for simple changes
Pro features (policy checks, drift detection) are $$$$ enterprise-only
Community edition lacks any safety analysis for production deployments

competitors.name: Atlas (Ariga)
competitors.description: Modern database schema management tool with declarative migrations.
complaints: Still early-stage with incomplete documentation and sparse community support
Declarative approach struggles with data migrations, not just schema changes
HCL configuration language has a steep learning curve for most backend devs

raw_complaint_pool: Our junior dev ran an `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN NOT NULL` and locked our 50GB table for 2 hours.
Database migration tools don't warn you if a migration will lock rows under heavy production traffic.
Need automated CI checks that simulate index creation on live table replicas.
We had a 4-hour production outage because a migration dropped a column that a running service still referenced.
Every migration tool assumes you can take downtime. In 2026, zero-downtime should be the default, not a paid feature.
I wish there was a tool that could tell me 'this ALTER will lock writes for ~45 minutes on your 200M row table' BEFORE I run it.
Our team spent 3 days debugging a migration that silently converted timestamps to dates and truncated all time data.
The cost of a single bad migration in production ($50K+ in lost revenue) far exceeds what any migration tool costs. Yet none of them focus on safety.
